This folder is used by GitHub Repository Visibility Manager v1.4.1.

The app stores a fresh repository-list cache here for up to 30 minutes.
Expired, invalid, token-mismatched, and older-version caches are rejected and
removed automatically. Use "Refresh from GitHub" inside the app to bypass the
cache, or File > Clear repository cache to remove it manually.

Do not place personal files in this folder.
